correctness.rationale: The harmonic-sum unique lowest valuation gives nu_2(1/(kH(k)))=floor(log2 k)-nu_2(k). For each odd part a and exponent t, W_t=2^{floor(log2 a)+t} H(a2^t) is odd, and W_{t+1}-W_t is 2^{floor(log2 a)+t+1} times a sum of odd reciprocals. Hence the inverse terms differ with valuation at least 2 floor(log2 a)+t+1. Exact odd-part decomposition of dyadic blocks yields nu_2(Delta_{r+1}-Delta_r)>=r, giving an odd limit C and a convergent normalized intercept D with the stated precision. Exact rational base residues at r=3..8 and telescoping prove G(2^r) congruent to 113r+11 modulo 256 for all r>=3. The self-contained verifier passes checks for 512 terms and 64 normalized unit transitions; infinite proof does not depend on finite extrapolation.
